instruction: Highlight all dates from the first 10 days of each month (dates 1-10) by setting the cell background as teal (#008080). Finish the work and don't touch irrelevant regions, even if they are blank.

metadata.explanation: Task requires highlighting dates with day number 1-10 in teal. Date-based conditional formatting. Verified: 50 cells with date day values 1-10.
metadata.verification: Verified by analyzing complete calendar data: 50 first_ten_days cells identified with Python script from 153 total date cells.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses hardcoded cell list (B3-F12) without runtime validation that these cells actually contain dates with day values 1-10
No semantic verification: the getter only extracts colors, not cell values, so it cannot verify that highlighted cells contain dates 1-10
Potential incomplete coverage: if calendar structure changes or contains dates 1-10 in other cells, they won't be verified
Risk of false positives: if cells in B3-F12 don't all contain dates 1-10, evaluator will incorrectly expect them to be highlighted
The evaluator assumes the pre-computed cell list is correct but cannot verify this assumption at runtime
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to extract both cell values AND colors, returning a dict with both pieces of information
Add logic to parse date values and identify which cells have day numbers 1-10
Update metric to: (1) verify that all cells with dates 1-10 are highlighted in teal, (2) verify that no other cells are highlighted in teal
Remove hardcoded cell list and make verification dynamic based on actual cell content analysis
